note: Each entry is a decision, not a measurement. `lines` is the ceiling that file may not exceed; `context`, `trackedBy` and `reason` say who holds the decision to keep it and why. `trackedBy` is the issue holding the decision, which is not always the issue that owns the decomposition: four of these six have no decomposition owner by design. Run `npm run file-size:report` to render this as the #778 index table, so the table is generated rather than retyped. See ADR-0044 and #1433.

apps/messenger-bot/src/modules/messenger.reason: No duplication finding. Raised by #1450 from 973 to 981: the concrete Redis-backed `RedisUserDisplayNameCache` injection became a port token, which costs the import, the `@Inject()` and a short note on why the parameter carries no `@Optional()`. Eight lines of wiring, no new behaviour. #1084 touches one optional-method cast and does not decompose it.

packages/bot-metrics/src/bot-metrics.ser.reason: Largest candidate. No decomposition owner. Unlike the other four it has no extracted sibling to build a seam on.

packages/chat-agent/src/agent/platform-a.reason: Decomposed by #1143: the ~290-line clarification handler moved to `clarification/` (pure core, responder, text parser) and the service keeps only a delegating facade over it. 1187 -> 939 lines. The split left the repository slightly larger, so by ADR-0044 it bought nothing on its own; it was made because a field-access prohibition is only enforceable once the code that read the fields lives somewhere the type system can constrain. What is left is chat orchestration, and no duplication finding is recorded against it.

packages/chat-agent/src/chat-queue/redis.reason: No duplication finding. Do not start before #774 retires the Messenger mirror spec; splitting now spends the spec work twice.

packages/chat-metering/src/chat-rate-lim.reason: Owned by #1080, which names itself the concrete plan for this file. Most duplicated candidate, not the largest.

packages/llm-agent/src/agent.service.ts.reason: Split once already by #438. Extracted collaborators total 1196 lines, so the split left the repository 69 lines larger, not 59% smaller.
